preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers, n and k are within the specified bounds, and n and k have the same parity.

postconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
postconditions.description: The output string s has length n and consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: min(len(t) for t in unique_substrings(s) if s.count(t) == 1) == k
postconditions.description: The length of the minimal unique substring of s is equal to k.
